name: example-8b-instruct-q4
_source: Illustrative values. Replace every field from the model you actually intend to serve: num_hidden_layers, num_key_value_heads and head_dim come from that model's own configuration file, and weight_file_bytes is the measured total of the downloaded weight files. Do not plan hardware from these numbers.

_alternative_when_not_yet_downloaded._note: Only for a first sizing pass. The tool marks the result as estimated because a quantised file mixes element widths between tensors.
